text.terms05: Pay US$1, or the local equivalent shown by Stripe, to reserve access to the exclusive Kickstarter secret reward for your selected tier. Its benefits are the same as that tier’s normal reward, with a 30% discount on its Kickstarter pledge price.
text.terms07: The US$1 fee is separate from the later Kickstarter pledge. It is not deducted from that pledge. It does not purchase the game, create a Kickstarter pledge, or automatically charge you the later pledge amount. When the campaign launches, you must separately select and pledge for the corresponding VIP secret reward on Kickstarter. Reward prices shown on this page are in euros. Optional add-ons are separate and are not covered by the 30% tier discount.
text.terms09: Use an email you can access at Stripe checkout. WonderLang records the email supplied with your verified payment and the selected reward tier, and will use that email to provide access to the corresponding secret reward when the campaign launches. Your reservation applies to the tier selected at checkout. Keep your Stripe payment receipt.
text.terms10: Cancel and request a refund anytime
text.terms11: You can cancel your reservation and request a refund of the reservation fee at any time by emailing jonathan@wonderlang.app. Please contact us from your checkout email and include your payment reference if available. A refunded reservation no longer provides VIP eligibility. Refunds are returned through Stripe to the original payment method; currency conversion and bank processing can affect the local amount and arrival time. If the campaign does not launch, you can request the same refund.
text.terms13: Stripe processes the payment and collects your checkout email and payment details. WonderLang keeps a private reservation record containing your email, selected tier and price, payment references, payment amount and currency, date, accepted terms version, and payment or refund status. We do not store card numbers in the reservation database. Only authorized WonderLang administrators can access the records. Your email is used to manage your reservation and provide the promised VIP access, not to automatically subscribe you to a newsletter. We retain the reservation record for administration and applicable accounting obligations. For access, correction, or deletion requests, email jonathan@wonderlang.app.
text.terms15: For new VIP reservations, we use Meta’s Conversions API to measure completed US$1 reservations and understand which ads bring people to WonderLang. Where tracking is permitted, we send Meta the verified reservation value, selected tier, a unique payment event reference, a SHA-256 hash of your checkout email, and available ad-click or browser identifiers, IP address, and browser information. We honor Global Privacy Control and your WonderLang marketing opt-out. This does not subscribe you to marketing emails. We also use the Meta browser pixel to measure page views, checkout starts and verified purchases. Browser and server purchases share an event ID to prevent double-counting, and your tracking choices apply to both.
text.terms16: This pre-launch page is operated by WonderLang. It is not a live Kickstarter campaign. A reservation does not guarantee the campaign will be successfully funded or that the game has already been released. Kickstarter’s terms apply to any later pledge made there.
